_about: Human-reviewed ground truth for a stratified 20-app sample (across all 10 categories, every auth pattern, and the easy->gated spectrum). Used by verify.py to compute per-field accuracy. Values are best-known as of the reviewer's check; CONFIRM against the evidence URL before trusting, and correct any you find stale — that is the point of the human loop.

labels.name: Salesforce
labels.note: Free Developer Edition org is self-serve; REST+SOAP+Bulk, very broad.

labels.name: HubSpot
labels.note: Private-app token or OAuth, free developer account.

labels.name: Zendesk
labels.note: Free trial account; API token/OAuth/basic.

labels.name: Slack
labels.note: Create a Slack app free; OAuth scopes. Some endpoints need workspace admin install.

labels.name: Twilio
labels.note: Account SID + Auth Token (HTTP basic); free trial credit.

labels.name: WhatsApp Business
labels.note: Meta app review + business verification required for production.

labels.name: Google Ads
labels.note: OAuth + developer token; token needs Google approval for production (Basic access).

labels.name: Mailchimp
labels.note: API key in dashboard, free account.

labels.name: Shopify
labels.note: Free partner + dev store; Admin REST+GraphQL, very broad. Shopify ships an MCP/dev tooling.

labels.name: Amazon Selling Partner
labels.note: LWA OAuth; developer registration + app approval, seller account required.

labels.name: Firecrawl
labels.note: API key on signup, free credits; official MCP server.

labels.name: Apify
labels.note: API token, free tier; Apify ships an MCP server.

labels.name: Sherlock
labels.note: Open-source CLI (hunt usernames). No hosted API/auth; edge case.

labels.name: GitHub
labels.note: PAT or OAuth, free; REST+GraphQL broad; official GitHub MCP server.

labels.name: Notion
labels.note: Internal integration token or OAuth, free; official Notion MCP.

labels.name: Linear
labels.note: Personal API key or OAuth, free; GraphQL; official Linear MCP.

labels.name: Stripe
labels.note: Secret API key, free test mode; REST very broad; official Stripe MCP.

labels.name: Plaid
labels.note: client_id + secret; free Sandbox self-serve. Production access needs approval (friction) — nuance.

labels.name: PitchBook
labels.note: No open self-serve API; data access via enterprise license / contact sales. LOW confidence — verify.

labels.name: Mermaid CLI
labels.note: Local npm CLI that renders diagrams. No hosted API/auth; edge case.
